source: Indiana 2017-2019 3DEP LiDAR Normalized Digital Height Model, 2018 collection
provider: Purdue Geospatial Data Science Lab / Indiana Digital Forestry
measurement_method: Transformed FID 647 WGS84 polygon to EPSG:2968 and sampled pixel centers strictly inside. Georeferencing uses tile origin (2,995,000 ftUS, 1,890,000 ftUS), 5 ft pixel size. Values are normalized surface height in feet; vegetation/edge mixed pixels remain possible.
uncertainty: NDHM estimates roof/vegetation surface above terrain, not a surveyed wall, eave, or ridge height; edge pixels and canopy can affect samples.
